reportingNotes: PT-007 already has two controlled covered/exposed comparisons; further work is regression coverage, not initial confirmation.
Delivery progress and rewards must be measured per live tab. Saved progress is loaded at start; multiple paused tabs retain separate in-memory baselines.
A flight workaround does not prove ground route unreachable. A kerb can be traversable by design; bridge parapets require separate controlled testing.
Recovery can choose a different legal heading and change GPS distance. Wait for glide/camera settling before judging forward clearance.
